latin: Qui sciuerit rationem causae praesupponere rationem perfecti, intelliget iuxta Platonicam doctrinam quare dixerit Pherecides non prius Iouem mundum fabricasse quam in amorem fuerit transformatus.
translation: Whoever knows that the concept of a cause presupposes the concept of the perfect will understand, according to Platonic doctrine, why Pherecydes said that Jupiter did not fashion the world before he had been transformed into Love.
